svg.text: KARTOGRAPH · CAPABILITY-CENTRED AI-NATIVE SDL · STATUS v3.0.0
Eight phases, twelve skills. Two planned human–AI sessions. Three rings, one stack.

Every phase is a skill, starts from a fresh context and reads only the files the previous phase wrote. The stack's design documents are pulled in at planning and read by every ring. Three runtimes, one source.
Ends when the playback is confirmed.
AUTONOMOUS AI STRETCH · SEPARATELY TRIGGERED, NEVER ASKING
Record the knowledge, specify the behaviour, plan three rings for the project's stack, build the screens on sample data, then the domain, then the adapters.
Every phase validates or tests its output, commits only its own directories and pushes. Each ring refuses to run until the previous ring's checkboxes are ticked.
No scheduled meeting. Anything undecided lands in the files as a stub, a collision, an open question or recorded friction. A walk can follow any ring.
After ring 1, 2 or 3, in voice mode:
the AI drives, the person judges.
Only their answer becomes a verdict.
– as a new intent in the next
scaffold stack before it can be
docs to steer every later run.
Uses the screens on sample data
Triggers the ring. May walk the
same screens again, now on real
Starts the app on the surface
Detects the stack, copies its docs
in; screens table, layer map, ports
Real code in every step, no TBD.
Hot Reload. No tests, no launch.
Per scenario: outer test at the
ViewModel on fake ports, red first;
Then, say what it sees, ask
reloads, resets or edits the app.
plus a Gherkin parser if there;
Ring-1 tasks ticked in the plan;
green, red first; no fake left;
2 / 3 / 4 / 6 / 7 → 1 · Stubs, collisions, open questions, and friction from planning or a ring are the agenda of the next session 1.
8 → 4 · A failed scenario whose spec still holds is re-planned, then the rings run again from the one that changed.
8 → 1 · A failed scenario that reveals a wrong or missing spec becomes a new intent (related: the old one); phases 2 to 8 run again.
STACKS · THREE READY, TWO SCAFFOLDS · NOT BUILT YET
stacks/kmp, apple-swift and python-fastapi are ready, each derived from the owner's own projects and conventions.
android-compose and angular-kotlin are scaffolds: every section present, every section UNFILLED;
plan refuses them. Delivery is kartograph-deliver; verify and observe still have no skill.
GUARDRAILS THAT HOLD IN EVERY PHASE
Never invent: what was not said becomes an assumption, an open question, a stub or friction. Every phase writes and
commits only its own directories. No “verified”, no “accepted” by the AI. Test first, never a weakened test, never a fake in
production. The plan is the contract, the code is the truth; deviations are reported, never silent. Vocabulary from knowledge/.
Human only when a decision is needed, later

End-to-end linkage: intent file → sources / # Source intent → capability.md → plans/ (stack: docs/code-design/) → feature-<capability>/ (+ core/, server/) → walks/. Status: Kartograph v3.0.0, 2026-09-24.

Skills: converse (interactive) · intent · map · knowledge · features · plan · screens · domain · adapters (fully automated, separately triggered) · walk (interactive, once per scenario) · deliver · migrate – Claude Code, Codex/ChatGPT and OpenCode from one source.
